Exact local order sums prove that its finite-support pushforward carries every principal divisor to the divisor of the reduced function, with no chart integrality restriction on the function. Closed place residues and the existing genus equality give a degree-preserving constant reduction with equal original and residue genera. Its literal pushforward descends to the actual degree-zero Picard groups and preserves torsion. Every positive-order torsion class in its kernel supplies a normalized Kummer function whose residue is an actual power. The actual modular consumers assume no place map, divisor compatibility, constant-reduction object, genus equality, Picard map or residue power.
